comment: Invalid on purpose: `add_star` gives an added atom the wildcard element, which the parser rejects because an added atom needs a real element. Used by the node tests to prove a load failure reaches the result pin.

tools.name: probe
tools.note: A bare probe: the whole tool model these fixtures need. Every operation here is `tip` and carries an empty tool side, so the frame is declared and never bound - none of these fixtures wires a tool.
